notes.title: Version 0.9.2
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Changed the backend - things should load quite a bit faster now.  Because of this, I removed the loading screens.   [i]It turns out that doing that touches a LOT of things.  Please let me know if you find any bugs.[/i]

[*] Meteor towers nerfed.  They fire slower and have a smaller splash radius

[*] Cannon towers fire slower

[*] Reduced range of rapidfire and blast towers

[*] increased range of sniper towers but slowed them down a bit
[/list]

Future list:

[list]
[*] Balance pass on turrets and orbitals.
[*] Add in some upgrades dealing with Damage Type interactions (e.g. frost then fire)
[*] Add in one round of wide but weak orbitals to help with these interactions.
[/list]

notes.title: Version 0.9e
notes.content:
[list]
[*]Fixed the slowdown caused by spawning bugs (Hatcherax)
[*]Fixed a bug preventing one level from loading
[*]Changed the Energy Infusion upgrade to 1% per energy above 1000.  Was 50%.  It was too dang high!
[/list]

Thanks again!

notes.title: Version 0.9d
notes.content:
Another small update to squash more bugs.

[list]
[*]Fixed a bug so now Poison Meteor towers are selectable and don't break the game.
[*] Hopefully fixed the system so that you shouldn't see TEXT123456789 on upgrades.  But will continue to monitor the situation.
[/list]

Thanks for the all the feedback!

notes.title: Version 0.9b
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Fixed a bug that was preventing a couple of levels from loading (oops)
[*] Added credits screen upon victory
[/list]

notes.title: version 0.9a
notes.content:
Very small patch to fix a boss:

[list]
[*]Nerfed Voidwing Monarch health by 5,000 - the fight was taking too long.
[*]Buffed the health of its spawns by 25% to compensate
[*]Fixed a bug at the end of that level that prevented players from selecting an upgrade 
[/list]

notes.title: Steam Next Fest
notes.content:
Small polishes here and there:
Added additional resolutions to choose from, for higher resolution setups and 16:10 ratio folks
Reworked the first few levels a little bit - should be a little less repetitive
Reworked the Swarm level - changed from Armored type to Deathstriders
Changed enemy names to be a bit more flavorful
Added some hints to loading screens while I try to get the game to load faster
The Incoming Enemies windows starts open at the start of each level.  It wasn't obvious that it was there.
Changed upgrade backgrounds to look better.


After Steam Next Fest, I'll be looking to add in a bunch of levels and upgrades and enemies.
